settings.title: Do more with less.
settings.body:
Postcard is a self-care destination, made in our beauty kitchen in Singapore. Effective natural recipes, simple ingredients, and the least wasteful packaging we can manage.

We're here to make care personal again — one honest little ritual at a time.

settings.title: Made by hand, made to last.
settings.body:
Every formula is mixed, poured and finished by hand in small batches — no shortcuts, no fillers you can't pronounce.

We start with what the skin actually needs, keep the ingredient list short, and pack it in the most refillable, least wasteful way we can.

settings.title: Made by a small team, for you.
settings.body: We started Postcard to make self-care honest again — simple, effective, and kinder to the planet. Everything you're holding was formulated and finished by our own hands.

settings.title: Bring the ritual home.
settings.body: Loved it here? The full Postcard range — deodorants, washes, refills and more — is a tap away.
